# Copilot instructions for this repo

Before making any code, config, docs, or test change, always read:
- AGENTS.md
- CLAUDE.md
- any relevant local docs in the current folder

Follow the repo rules in AGENTS.md before editing or proposing changes.
Do not skip the project instructions, even for small fixes.
If the task touches frontend behavior, also check the relevant feature or route docs before changing code.
